70
text:
Example: 2 of 3 milestones and 1 of 2 sessions
70 × (2/3) + 30 × (1/2) = 61.7%

Illustrative arithmetic examples, not seeded-user scenarios. Matching total is round(skill overlap*50 + availability ratio*30 + experience ratio*20), clamped 0–100. Availability ratios: exact 1, flexible .9, missing .6, incompatible .2. Experience affinity: +1/+2 tiers 1, +3 .9, same .65, lower .25. Skill overlap uses shared skills / learner skills, or .5 when none selected. Progress uses 70/30 when both types exist, 100% for the only existing type, 0% for no records. COMPLETED forces100%, rather than assessing competency.

name: Updates run synchronously in application handlers.
text: Updates run synchronously in application handlers.

Conceptual relationship diagram: Mentorship references two User records. Profile is one-to-one to User, RoleAssignment is many-to-one. Progress is one-to-one to Mentorship. Sessions,milestones,resources and posts have foreign keys to Mentorship. Completion handler invokes reward service and recalculates progress. Reward service checks badges and refreshes ranks; notification helper records events. Updates need no background queue.
